peers.name: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers Limited

bull_bear.body:
- Deleveraging under the Joint Settlement Agreement with the 14-bank consortium: 7 of 14 lenders fully repaid and discharged ahead of scheduled due dates, more than 96% of the outstanding debt of the remaining 7 banks discharged (less than 4% balance), with a debt-free target in the ongoing quarter (Q2FY27).
- Debt resolution milestones: One-Time Settlement proposal submitted Dec 2023; Joint Settlement Agreement executed 30 Sep 2024; more than 50% of bank debt discharged till end-FY25; ~68% reduction till Q3FY26 (Dec 2025); more than 90% reduction by Apr 2026; more than 96% by Aug 2026.
- Equity raise: "fund raising of Rs 2,702.11 crores via Preferential issue of fully convertible warrants was completed successfully during the quarter ended June 2026 with realization of 93% of the issue proceeds"; since quarter-end, a further 4.16 crore warrants were converted into equity shares, described as continued promoter support that strengthens the equity base.
- In July 2026 the Board approved raising up to Rs1,000 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement in one or more tranches, subject to requisite approvals, "primarily used to support future growth opportunities, strengthen financial flexibility and enhance the Company's ability to scale its operations".
- Way Forward: "With surplus cash, no further finance cost and the strategic turnaround underway, the company expects sustained value creation for its shareholders"; no dividend policy is stated.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Established in 2005 - among the leading players in the Indian Wedding Jewellery Market", described as a "Leading Brand with a Strong Legacy" and "Positioned among Top Studded Jewellery brands in India".
- Extensive market reach claimed as a "Wide network of showrooms across 12 States in India along with e-commerce platform", with a "Combination of Franchisee owned as well as Company owned Showrooms"; states listed are Jammu, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Haryana, Delhi and Punjab.
- At-a-glance metrics: FY26 Revenue Rs3,353 Crores, FY26 Operating EBITDA Rs671 Crores with a 20% FY26 Operating EBITDA margin (consolidated, excludes other income), total retail area 2.05 lakh sq ft as on 30-Jun-26 and market cap Rs8,506 Cr as on 30-Jun-26.
- "Way Forward" cites core strengths "in the form of manufacturing & designing capabilities, manufacturing facilities, skilled staff, soft skills in the form of systems and procedures, customer policies, etc. intact".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Mining / vertical integration] During the quarter ended June 2026, PCJ Mining SARL, a step-down subsidiary, was granted a licence for semi-mechanized artisanal mining of gold by the Ministry of Petroleum, Mining and Oil Geology, Republic of Chad; management expects "production through mining activities to commence in this financial year itself", creating an opportunity to explore mining and possible vertical integration.
- [Government partnerships] MoUs executed with NSDC (Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship) and with the Government of Uttar Pradesh under the CM YUVA scheme for onboarding entrepreneurs under the PC Jeweller brand; participation is positioned to enhance brand visibility and align with industry formalisation.
- [Industry backdrop] The deck cites an Indian jewellery market moving from 67.0 to 140.0 ($Bn, per the slide title "A $140 Billion Opportunity") between 2023 and 2029E at +12%-14%, with organised share shown as 29% (2018), 35% (2023) and 45% (2028P) against unorganized 71%/65%/55%; it also states "Mid-size retailers account for 70% of sales with expected shift to regional and national chain on the back of increasing regulatory compliances."
- [Industry - studded] "Diamond/Studded Jewellery Market in India is expected to grow at +21% CAGR by FY28", with a chart series of 7, 10, 13 and 41 against 2018, 2021, 2023 and 2028P whose unit is not stated in the extract; the accompanying 21%-23%, 16% and 10% share figures cannot be reliably bound to their years.
- [Advisor] The deck's closing contact page lists Ernst & Young LLP contacts (Rohit Anand, Dhruv Bansal, Riddhant Kapur) alongside the Company's investor email.

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions PC Jeweller as a legacy wedding- and studded-jewellery retailer in the middle of a turnaround - clearing a 14-bank consortium settlement to reach debt-free status in the ongoing quarter, recapitalised through promoter warrants and a proposed QIP, and preparing an asset-light, franchise-led push into Tier 2/3 and rural markets alongside a new gold-mining licence in Chad.

themes.title: Jewellery & wedding-economy formalization
themes.need: Organized jewellery is gaining share via capital-light FOCO expansion and GST/hallmarking formalization, even amid record gold-price volatility. KALYANKJIL posted Q4 revenue +66% YoY with 150 new FY27 stores and a near-zero non-GML-debt target; SENCO/PNGJL/DPABHUSHAN ride regional formalization; SKYGOLD/RGL/GOLDIAM on B2B and lab-grown export; KALAMANDIR on the wedding-wear economy.
themes.driver: Akshaya Tritiya / wedding-season demand; FOCO store rollout; gold-price stabilization lifting volumes.
